# X360 Mobile 0.6.1 Public Revision 1

This maintenance revision keeps the 0.6.1 feature line while delivering the
user-visible fixes and improvements completed after the last distributed
0.6.1 APK. It uses the same package and signing identity, so it installs as an
in-place update without removing application data.

## Display and device orientation

- The splash screen, library and emulator now support both sensor-driven
  landscape orientations.
- Phones, tablets and handhelds may be rotated 180 degrees to place attached
  controls on the preferred side.
- Portrait orientation remains disabled throughout the application.

## Audio resilience

- Added adaptive Android audio buffering for environments that repeatedly
  interrupt normal playback scheduling.
- Healthy sessions retain the existing low-latency behavior. Additional
  buffering is enabled only after repeated playback underruns are observed.
- Added delayed output-route refreshes for gaming environments that finish
  applying their audio policy shortly after launch.
- Proprietary audio effects remain under Android and the device vendor's
  control; this mitigation does not attempt to replace or bypass them.

## Controller and interface improvements

- Native one-action message boxes now receive controller focus automatically
  and may be dismissed with controller B, Android Back or Escape.
- Invalid GamerTags now show the applicable naming guidance when Create or
  Save is unavailable.
- The native master-volume control now provides contextual guidance and an
  explicit muted state.
- Remaining source-verification, compatibility, update, profile, log-export
  and touch-control labels are localized in English, Italian, German, Spanish
  and French.

## Reliability and efficiency

- Corrected ASCII uppercase conversion while preserving non-ASCII UTF-8 text.
- Made network-address formatting safe for null, empty and truncated guest
  output buffers.
- Reduced temporary allocations during game-patch discovery and common string
  trimming.
- Reduced repeated GamerTag validation setup and avoidable emulator lifecycle
  bookkeeping.

## Package information

- Package: `emu.x360mobile.com`.
- Version: `0.6.1-public.1` (`versionCode 6019001`).
- Public artifact: `x360-mobile-0.6.1-public.1.apk`.
- Channel: Public; the GitHub release is not marked as a prerelease.
- Release packages use managed-code shrinking and resource optimization,
  stripped ARM64 native libraries, the established X360 Mobile signing
  identity and APK Signature Scheme v3 with a local v4 sidecar.

## Known limitations

- Online compatibility-report submission remains temporarily disabled while
  that service is redesigned. Local reports and the read-only catalog remain
  available.
- Vendor-specific DSP effects and gaming-space audio policies may still need
  to be disabled by the user if the OEM does not expose a standard Android
  route or scheduling change.
